messages:
Priya: Kicking off TealRidge onboarding. Goals: align owners, define success metrics, and agree a 30/60-day milestone plan. Renewal horizon noted for 2028-10.
Marta (TealRidge): Thanks Priya  our priority is accurate clinical guidance and PII controls. We want SSO + audit exports.
Evan: Ill own ingest and initial prompt tuning. Need a redacted CSV and a list of canonical QA prompts. ETA: scaffold in ~8 business days after files.
Rafael: Platform will stand up a sandbox cluster and a staging model. Need allowlist IPs and a service account. Infra tasks ~3 business days after allowlist.
June (Security): For PII we need field classification and a signed DPA/BAA before prod. Will send the security checklist. Audit export supported on Private; hosted needs add-on.
Priya: Proposed success criteria:
- End-to-end sandbox: ingest -> embeddings -> chat with redacted dataset
- Okta SSO enabled with 3 test users
- Staging median latency p50 <350ms
- Compliance checklist & signed DPA
- Handoff + KT recorded
All good?
Marta (TealRidge): Yes. Also request 12-month log retention and an exportable audit CSV for regulators.
June (Security): We can configure 12m retention on Dedicated/Private, and provide an export procedure for Hosted.
Evan: Small perf note  what concurrency should we plan for? That affects batching config.
Marta (TealRidge): Start with 30 concurrent clinician sessions, burst to 100.
Priya: Risks:
- Delayed redacted sample (blocks ingest)
- Okta metadata issues (SSO delay)
- Legal delays on DPA
- Quality regression after aggressive quantization
Action items (owner + due date):
- Marta: share redacted sample + schema (due Thu)
- Evan: ingest scaffold & mapping doc (due next Mon)
- Rafael: provision sandbox + confirm IPs (due Fri)
- June: DPA checklist & retention options (due Wed)
- Priya: create weekly cadence + onboarding doc (due today)
calendar-bot: Meeting created: "TealRidge Onboarding - Weekly" Mon 09:00 PT starting 3923457000
Evan: Quick config snippet well need from customer:
```
S3_BUCKET=tealridge-sandbox
PREFIX=uploads/
REDACT_FIELDS=name,email,ssn
```
Marta (TealRidge): Copy  will provision and DM creds to Evan. Legal looped in for DPA.
Priya: Ill post the Confluence checklist & invite link here when ready. Ping me if anything urgent. :rocket:
